choice: Release the Houdini port under GPL-3.0-or-later, reuse A3OB code where useful, keep MrClock/Alwarren attribution. Repo stays private for now.
context: A3OB is GPL-3.0-or-later; reusing its pure-Python io code makes the port a derivative work.
title: Port license: GPL-3.0-or-later

context: Owner runs Houdini Indie 22.0.466 (Python 3.13). H21 support would force Python 3.11 compatibility.
title: Target Houdini 22 only

choice: Defer; revisit before any HDA is distributed. Keep logic in Python modules so HDAs stay thin and rebuildable.
context: HDAs saved from Houdini Indie may be limited-commercial (.hdalc), affecting full-Houdini users. Unverified.
title: Defer Indie .hdalc HDA licensing question

alternatives: python3.13libs/ only (ties code to Houdini Python version); src/ layout with pip install (needs install step in hython)
choice: python/a3ob_core (pure, no hou/bpy/numpy) + python/a3ob_houdini (hou glue) + houdini/ (package content root) + packages/a3ob_houdini.json + tests/ + scripts/run_tests.py + docs/design/
context: Format I/O must be testable outside Houdini (brief, design point 10).
title: Repo layout: pure core vs Houdini glue

choice: unittest only; same suite runs via python scripts/run_tests.py and hython scripts/run_tests.py; pure layer has no third-party deps (no numpy)
context: pytest is not installed in system Python 3.12, hython ships no pytest; uv not installed.
title: Tests: stdlib unittest, zero dependencies

choice: Use Bohemia's official Arma 3 Samples (Steam) MLOD p3d files as real-file test data. Keep them local/gitignored unless the Samples license permits committing; tests skip when absent.
context: Fixtures are only 2 small A3OB samples; OQ-5 (code page) and OQ-11 (blob TAGGs) need real Object Builder MLODs.
title: Real-file test data: Bohemia Arma 3 Samples

alternatives: see the alternatives column of each OQ in the spec
choice: OQ-1 axis map P=(x,y,-z). OQ-2 proxies as PackedGeometry prims, inline fallback automatic. OQ-3 keep collected LOD order on export; sort is an option, validator warns when unsorted. OQ-4 a3ob_mass + copy helper to/from Houdini mass. OQ-6 explicit prim groups only when face bytes differ from the derived rule, plus an import option for always. OQ-7 importer outputs the P3D container plus an unpack-LOD-k helper/option. OQ-8 float64 UVs accepted. OQ-9 export all point groups except __*, with a mask parameter (default '* ^__*'). OQ-10 accept a non-identity LOD transform, bake once, fix winding for det<0, warn. OQ-12 keep empty/duplicate selection names and repeated UV-set ids as raw blobs.
context: Owner reviewed docs/design/houdini-data-model.md 'Open questions for the owner' with the advisor, one at a time.
title: M2 data-model open questions OQ-1..OQ-4, OQ-6..OQ-10, OQ-12 resolved as recommended

choice: The importer writes a per-prim int a3ob_lod_uid on every LOD's polygons from the start. The validator errors (or warns) exactly when one LOD geometry holds two or more distinct uids. The count heuristic stays as a secondary warning. The lead defines uid generation (unique per import, survives copy/pack) and behaviour for authored LODs without a uid.
context: A Merge of unpacked LODs silently keeps only the first input's detail attributes. The spec recommended a count-based heuristic warning first, with a uid added later.
title: OQ-13: per-prim LOD uid now (not heuristic-only)

choice: Keep cp1252 + C1 for now. Settle OQ-5 and test the OQ-11 blob paths against Bohemia Arma 3 Samples MLODs (D6). Synthetic tests until then.
context: Code page (cp1252 vs cp1250) and blob-TAGG coverage need real Object Builder files.
title: OQ-5 and OQ-11 deferred to Arma 3 Samples evidence

alternatives: fewer nodes/more shelf; one /obj per LOD (Blender-like); /out ROP first; GEOio File-SOP converter
choice: NODES (procedural, re-cook on change): P3D Import; Extract LOD / Assemble LODs; LOD Properties (type, resolution, named props, LOD copies); Proxy (path, index, placement); Material/texture assign (a3ob_texture/a3ob_material on a group); Mass (set/uniform/density/centre of mass); Validate (standalone node, and built into export; problems surface as node warnings/errors); P3D Export as a SOP-level output node with file path + Save to Disk (a /out ROP wrapper later). SHELF: quick Export button; Selection browser (decoded P3D names); project root + presets; batch folder convert; 'New P3D' starter template (Res 1, Geometry, Memory LODs with LOD Properties, mass on Geometry, Assemble, Export). WORKFLOW: one SOP network per model: Import > Extract LOD branches > edit > Assemble > Export, with untouched LODs passing through. IMPORT: dedicated node only (no GEOio/File SOP converter for now). AUDIENCE: owner first, community release later.
context: Owner UX walkthrough with the advisor, 2026-11-03. Real Houdini node types require HDAs, which D3 defers; see the packaging spike.
title: UX: node vs shelf split and workflow shape

alternatives: real Indie HDAs now; no HDAs (Python SOPs)
choice: Run a packaging spike before M3 builds nodes, then choose between real HDAs and Python-SOP-based fake nodes based on the evidence. M3 code keeps node logic in python/ modules, so either wrapper works.
context: D3 deferred HDAs: Indie-saved HDAs carry the limited-commercial tag. Audience is the owner first, community later.
title: Node shipping: decide after an HDA packaging spike

choice: Set [machine] legacy_lock = false in houdiniArma3's aesir.toml. Gates still take a machine slot and the worker budget (max_gates 3). The residual risk of overlapping with old-release gates is accepted (tiny unittest suite).
context: Gates were starved by the machine-wide legacy lock held by E:/Projects/Aesir and voxel-terrarium; gate #1 timed out after 25 min for a 5 s suite.
title: Gate concurrency: legacy_lock = false for houdiniArma3
